finalPass.title: Final render of the film
finalPass.intro: Each shot starts from its selected take, which serves as the reference: its motion and framing are kept. Each finished final render goes on its shot, and the draft stays in the shot's takes.
finalPass.method.label: Method
finalPass.hint.upscale: Automatic: a take of the base MiniMax H3 preset goes through its own upscale mode, the others through SeedVR2, or RTX when SeedVR2 is missing. The motion does not change.
finalPass.hint.rtx: RTX: sharp and faithful, a few seconds per take; it adds no detail. The motion does not change.
finalPass.hint.rtxUnchecked: RTX: sharp and faithful, a few seconds per take; it adds no detail. The motion does not change. It runs on the remote worker if the nvidia-vfx package is installed there, which this server cannot check: the take fails otherwise.
finalPass.hint.seedvr2: SeedVR2: restores and adds detail; slow; it can retouch a texture or a face. The motion does not change.
finalPass.hint.engine: Engine: the take goes through its own engine again (MiniMax H3); it keeps its look, but the picture changes a little.
finalPass.targetAuto: Auto: each take gets the size the film's export needs, from its format and framing, up to 4K.
finalPass.hint.guided: LTX-2.5 renders each shot again in {res}, following its take through the Layout-To-Render IC-LoRA: same motion and framing, new detail. Experimental: slower, and the look can drift from the take.
finalPass.hint.guidedMissing: A guided render needs LTX-2.5 and the Layout-To-Render IC-LoRA: ask an administrator to install them.
finalPass.hint.render: Each shot is generated again at the largest size of its engine with the same seed. It does not follow the take: the result can differ.
finalPass.placement: A new render keeps the subject and the look of each take, not its layout: the larger size changes the starting noise, so objects and framing move. A guided render keeps the layout.
finalPass.placementNoGuided: A new render keeps the subject and the look of each take, not its layout: the larger size changes the starting noise, so objects and framing move. To keep the layout, upscale.
finalPass.oldRatio.one: {count} shot has a take in another ratio than its engine makes now for {aspect}: Upscale keeps that ratio, Render again takes the new one.
finalPass.oldRatio.other: {count} shots have a take in another ratio than their engine makes now for {aspect}: Upscale keeps that ratio, Render again takes the new one.
finalPass.sound.upscale: Sound: the sound of each take is kept.
finalPass.sound.guided: Sound: the sound of each take is laid on the new one; a silent take stays silent.
finalPass.sound.render: Sound: made again as for the draft (reference tracks cut again, sound of the engine generated again).
